data.title: Safe and ethical AI advocate calls international cooperation "absolutely essential"
data.description: OpenAI on Thursday revealed an additional six incidents in which its artificial intelligence models exhibited unexpected or concerning behavior. Stuart Russell, a distinguished professor of computer science at UC Berkeley and president of the International Association for Safe and Ethical AI, joins CBS News to discuss.
data.keywords: Technology, Cybercrime, Xi Jinping, OpenAI, Donald Trump, China, Artificial Intelligence, UC Berkeley
